We can accept a 72-hour review window if that helps. I attached the latest Order Form (BH_OrderForm_v3.pdf) for your records.

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: press announcement + logo use for joint pilot

Connor —

Thanks for the ping. Reviewed the attached Order Form. Two quick observations and a proposed minimal insertion so legal can sign off without escalating to full MSA amendment: 

1) Add an Order Form addendum clause ("Publicity and References") with a narrow scope:
- Permitted uses: one press release, one blog post, and one marketing slide as requested.
- Attribution: Blue Horizon may refer to Redwood Inference by name and include a 1-sentence customer quote only if Redwood provides written approval for the quote (approval window: 72 business hours).
- Logo use: Blue Horizon must use the logo artwork supplied by Redwood and abide by Redwood's trademark guidelines. No alteration of the logo beyond sizing and placement.
- No endorsement: no statement suggesting product endorsement or benchmarking numbers without prior written consent.

2) Confidentiality carve-out: Maintain existing confidentiality in the MSA but add a carve-out that allows Redwood and Blue Horizon to make the permitted public announcement described above. The carve-out should explicitly state it does not waive any other confidentiality obligations (e.g., no disclosure of pricing, detailed metrics, or customer PII).

Proposed short clause (for insertion in Order Form, plain text):
"Customer and Supplier may mutually agree to a public announcement limited to one press release, one public blog post, and one marketing slide referencing the relationship and a short customer quote. Any customer quote or direct attribution to Supplier requires Supplier's prior written approval (Supplier will use reasonable efforts to review within 72 business hours). Logo artwork will be provided by Supplier and used in accordance with Supplier's brand guidelines. This public announcement provision does not permit disclosure of confidential pricing, product performance benchmarks, or customer personal data."

If you want a redline, I've attached an MSA_redline_snippet.docx with the language placed in an Addendum. Key question for marketing: do we want to allow anonymized case studies (e.g., "a major retailer used...") in addition to named references? If yes, we should permit anonymized references without approval but require a 5-business-day notice to the other party. I recommend we keep anonymized references off the table for this pilot.

I'll fast-track a redline for the Order Form addendum if you confirm the scope.

—Olga
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: MSA_redline_snippet.docx (docx)

Connor / Olga —

We can provide the following immediately:
- Master logo pack (SVG, PNG transparent, color-on-white, color-on-dark). I uploaded a zip to Drive and attached a stub here (BH_logo_pack_SVG_and_PNG.zip).
- Brand guidelines: short list of do's and don'ts — no cropping, maintain clearspace, don't add effects, and do not change colors.
- Approval: Marketing can review and approve the final quote for publication; legal sign-off is required only for quote text that references product performance.

For Blue Horizon's request, this is standard. If we accept Olga's proposed clause, marketing asks for the 72-hour window to be clarified as "72 business hours" (so it excludes weekends) and to add a point that the logos must be removed from any repurposed paid ads or collateral that go live after the initial announcement unless separately approved.

I recommend we: (a) accept the addendum language from Olga, (b) provide the logo pack, and (c) confirm the 72 business hour review window in the clause.

—Kimberly

Lauren —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We've consolidated legal and marketing feedback below and attached the redlined snippet for insertion into the Order Form as an addendum. Summary:

- Publicity allowed: one press release, one blog post, and one marketing slide.
- Attribution/quote: Blue Horizon may reference Redwood by name and include a 1-sentence customer quote only after Redwood's prior written approval. Approval window: 72 business hours.
- Logo: Redwood will provide the official logo pack. Use limited to the channels listed above; no use in paid advertising or promotional placements beyond the initial announcement unless separately approved. No alterations to the logo.
- Confidentiality: The addendum carves out the permitted announcement only; it does not permit disclosure of pricing, internal metrics, or customer personal data.

Next steps for Blue Horizon to finalize:
1) Confirm acceptance of the attached addendum language (we can incorporate into BH_OrderForm_v3.pdf).
2) Send the proposed public-facing quote text (one sentence) for review.
3) If accepted, we will add the addendum to the Order Form and countersign; please allow up to 3 business days for final countersignature after we receive the quote (72 business hours for review + processing).

Connor will share a Drive link to the logo pack (attached here as a stub) once you confirm. Happy to expedite if this is time-sensitive.

—Connor
